Subject: Two questions before we speak
Date: Tuesday 13 October 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Delphine Roux <delphine.roux@pellowventures.example.test>

Delphine,

Before Thursday, two questions. Does the portfolio company own its own model weights, or are they licensed? And is the data residency requirement contractual or a preference?

No need to write back if it is easier to cover them on the call.

Best,
Dom
notes: Questions only, with an explicit release from replying.
